I think gift cards are important because some people will want to only be paid with gift cards to have as minimal paper trails as possible.

If you can gather as much evidence as Paxful and LocalMonero used for their rules around what was required with gift cards and for dispute resolution, and we can put that into some really easy-to-understand and clear information for gift card purchasers and sellers, then I think we should definitely be using them and accepting them.
